findings.location: Section “1. Hands-off Courtship,” Scripture quotation (1 Corinthians 7:1-2)
findings.source_quote: “Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «ولكن لسبب الزنى» with «ولكن لتجنب الزنى» so the quotation conveys avoiding fornication, rather than acting because of it.
findings.translation_quote: «ولكن لسبب الزنى، ليكن لكل واحد امرأته، وليكن لكل واحدة رجلها»
